content: The current MCP 2025-11-25 specification makes cancellation a request-ID-scoped notification for ordinary in-flight requests: notifications/cancelled carries the previously issued requestId and optional reason; receivers should stop processing, free associated resources, and send no response, while tolerating unknown/already-completed IDs and races. For task-augmented requests, tasks/cancel is the required mechanism instead. MCP lifecycle guidance says implementations should set per-request timeouts, issue cancellation when the timeout expires, and still enforce a maximum timeout even if progress is used. Stdio shutdown is transport/process based: close child input, wait, then SIGTERM/SIGKILL as needed. The project already maps request IDs to AbortControllers and suppresses a cancelled response, but roadmap requirements should make reason logging, cleanup, duplicate/late cancellation, process EOF, and per-host timeout behavior explicit. Cross-checked against current official MCP lifecycle, schema, and cancellation pages.
